description: 1. A CI step on pull requests (ci/ script run by .github/workflows/ci.yml) fails when the PR modifies or deletes an existing file under test/stability/<version>/ (a release adds a directory; a frozen file is never edited), and when test/stability/codes.txt loses a code (the ledger only grows). Needs the base branch in the checkout (fetch-depth or a fetch of main). 2. codes.txt marks a retired code on its line (code, then 'retired <version>'); the ledger test asserts a marked code is kind :retired in the registry and every retired registry code is marked, so reactivating a retired code fails mix test and retiring one is a reviewed ledger edit. 3. docs/agents/stability.md states that the Markdown form Defk.LanguageDoc.extract/1 reads is a format contract: the extractor must keep reading every frozen file of every version. Done when mix ci passes and a PR that edits a frozen file fails the new step (try locally with the script).

comments.text: PR #14 opened: ci/frozen.sh guard on pull requests, retired marks in the ledger, the frozen form's contract in docs/agents/stability.md

title: Stability: guard the frozen files in CI, mark retired codes in the ledger, write down the extractor's format contract
